parameters.name: CnameEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable public cloud disaster recovery. Valid values:

- **true**: Public cloud disaster recovery is enabled.

- **false**: Public cloud disaster recovery is not enabled.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
